answer: A farm can name its wallets cedar, zenith and mesa, but it can't burn the same coin three times. Give one vote-weight unit per coin burned as a fee on a finalized job. The ledger consumes each fee receipt once, and there's no bonus per wallet. Splitting a budget buys no extra influence, and wash jobs still burn real fees. Rich operators can buy more weight, but extra identities don't make it cheaper.
